promoted_declarations.name: DkMath.NumberTheory.GapFocusing.GN_succ_right
promoted_declarations.statement:
theorem GN_succ_right {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] (d : ℕ) (x u : R) :
    GTail (d + 1) 1 x u = u * GTail d 1 x u + (x + u) ^ d

promoted_declarations.name: DkMath.NumberTheory.GapFocusing.GN_succ_left
promoted_declarations.statement:
theorem GN_succ_left {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] (d : ℕ) (x u : R) :
    GTail (d + 1) 1 x u = (x + u) * GTail d 1 x u + u ^ d

promoted_declarations.name: DkMath.NumberTheory.GapFocusing.GN_succ_unit_anchor
promoted_declarations.statement:
theorem GN_succ_unit_anchor {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] (d : ℕ) (x : R) :
    GTail (d + 1) 1 x 1 = (x + 1) * GTail d 1 x 1 + 1

promoted_declarations.name: DkMath.NumberTheory.GapFocusing.GN_succ_bezout
promoted_declarations.statement:
theorem GN_succ_bezout {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (d : ℕ) (x : R) :
    GTail (d + 1) 1 x 1 - (x + 1) * GTail d 1 x 1 = 1

promoted_declarations.name: DkMath.NumberTheory.GapFocusing.GN_succ_isCoprime_unit_anchor
promoted_declarations.statement:
theorem GN_succ_isCoprime_unit_anchor {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (d : ℕ) (x : R) :
    IsCoprime (GTail d 1 x 1) (GTail (d + 1) 1 x 1)

promoted_declarations.name: DkMath.NumberTheory.GapFocusing.dvd_anchor_pow_of_dvd_adjacent_GN
promoted_declarations.statement:
theorem dvd_anchor_pow_of_dvd_adjacent_GN
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (d : ℕ) (x u q : R)
    (hd : q ∣ GTail d 1 x u) (hs : q ∣ GTail (d + 1) 1 x u) :
    q ∣ u ^ d

promoted_declarations.name: DkMath.NumberTheory.GapFocusing.dvd_sum_pow_of_dvd_adjacent_GN
promoted_declarations.statement:
theorem dvd_sum_pow_of_dvd_adjacent_GN
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (d : ℕ) (x u q : R)
    (hd : q ∣ GTail d 1 x u) (hs : q ∣ GTail (d + 1) 1 x u) :
    q ∣ (x + u) ^ d

promoted_declarations.name: DkMath.NumberTheory.GapFocusing.nat_dvd_powers_of_dvd_adjacent_GN
promoted_declarations.statement:
theorem nat_dvd_powers_of_dvd_adjacent_GN
    (d x u q : ℕ) (hd : q ∣ GTail d 1 x u)
    (hs : q ∣ GTail (d + 1) 1 x u) :
    q ∣ u ^ d ∧ q ∣ (x + u) ^ d

promoted_declarations.name: DkMath.NumberTheory.GapFocusing.nat_prime_dvd_coordinates_of_dvd_adjacent_GN
promoted_declarations.statement:
theorem nat_prime_dvd_coordinates_of_dvd_adjacent_GN
    (d x u : ℕ) {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    (hd : p ∣ GTail d 1 x u) (hs : p ∣ GTail (d + 1) 1 x u) :
    p ∣ x ∧ p ∣ u

promoted_declarations.name: DkMath.NumberTheory.GapFocusing.nat_coprime_adjacent_GN
promoted_declarations.statement:
theorem nat_coprime_adjacent_GN (d x u : ℕ) (h : x.Coprime u) :
    (GTail d 1 x u).Coprime (GTail (d + 1) 1 x u)

promoted_declarations.name: DkMath.NumberTheory.GapFocusing.nat_one_lt_GN_succ
promoted_declarations.statement:
theorem nat_one_lt_GN_succ (d x u : ℕ)
    (hd : 0 < d) (hx : 0 < x) (hu : 0 < u) :
    1 < GTail (d + 1) 1 x u

promoted_declarations.name: DkMath.NumberTheory.GapFocusing.nat_exists_prime_dvd_GN_succ_not_dvd_GN
promoted_declarations.statement:
theorem nat_exists_prime_dvd_GN_succ_not_dvd_GN (d x u : ℕ)
    (hd : 0 < d) (hx : 0 < x) (hu : 0 < u) (h : x.Coprime u) :
    ∃ p : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ p ∣ GTail (d + 1) 1 x u ∧ ¬p ∣ GTail d 1 x u

promoted_declarations.name: DkMath.NumberTheory.GapFocusing.dvd_GN_of_dvd_coordinates
promoted_declarations.statement:
theorem dvd_GN_of_dvd_coordinates
    {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] (d : ℕ) (x u q : R)
    (hx : q ∣ x) (hu : q ∣ u) :
    q ∣ GTail (d + 2) 1 x u

promoted_declarations.name: DkMath.NumberTheory.GapFocusing.nat_prime_dvd_adjacent_GN_iff
promoted_declarations.statement:
theorem nat_prime_dvd_adjacent_GN_iff
    (d x u : ℕ) {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    (p ∣ GTail (d + 2) 1 x u ∧ p ∣ GTail (d + 3) 1 x u) ↔
      p ∣ x ∧ p ∣ u

promoted_declarations.name: DkMath.NumberTheory.GapFocusing.nat_coprime_adjacent_GN_iff
promoted_declarations.statement:
theorem nat_coprime_adjacent_GN_iff (d x u : ℕ) :
    (GTail (d + 2) 1 x u).Coprime (GTail (d + 3) 1 x u) ↔ x.Coprime u

promoted_declarations.name: DkMath.NumberTheory.GapFocusing.isCoprime_adjacent_GN
promoted_declarations.statement:
theorem isCoprime_adjacent_GN
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (d : ℕ) (x u : R) (h : IsCoprime x u) :
    IsCoprime (GTail d 1 x u) (GTail (d + 1) 1 x u)

promoted_declarations.name: DkMath.NumberTheory.GapFocusing.int_gcd_adjacent_GN_eq_one
promoted_declarations.statement:
theorem int_gcd_adjacent_GN_eq_one (d : ℕ) (x u : ℤ) (h : Int.gcd x u = 1) :
    Int.gcd (GTail d 1 x u) (GTail (d + 1) 1 x u) = 1
